name: Mac stays usable
ownerWords:
look it's you and ops guys responsibility that this machine is usable.

you -harness side of bullshit, ops guy -app side of bullshit fixing monitoring

setup a 60min cadence duty
goal: No minute of the hour reads unusable in ops guy's pressure feed (pressure critical, 6,000+ swapouts a second, or kernel_task over one core). A minute is the harness's with over 14 agent turns working or over 16 GB in Prime workers: under both, 0 of 337 measured minutes on 10-14 and 10-15 were unusable.

metrics.label: Share of the last hour's minutes the Mac was usable
Unusable minutes with over 14 agent turns or 16 GB in Prime workers (harness)
Unusable minutes with the harness under both lines (app or owner side)

onMiss: Push until green; never only report. Read the detail's harness_side and other_side lines. Harness minutes: start one fix job (await rlm.create_session(brief, name=..., cwd="/Users/sieunpark/Documents/Github/sieun-pi")) or message the live one an earlier run started. It finds which trees put turns over 14 or workers over 16 GB (fan-outs, live jobs, pi-pool admits), fixes pi-pool or the chat service with a test, commits, releases, and presses Run now until it reads 0. Other-side minutes: an app owner (pm2, docker, dev server) or the owner's own app on top: tell this chat one line with the minutes, the owner and its GB for ops guy. Never kill a session mid-turn, restart the Prime daemon or :5182, or message another chat. All on target: end with no message.
